messages:
Lina Park: Opening a docs PR to cover an air-gapped bootstrap flow for Private deployments that use an external HSM for signing. Need: CA bundle packaging guidance, a checksum + GPG verification example for the offline bundle, minimal CoreDNS conditional forward example, and a short HSM reachability test. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1422 

security-bot: PR created by Lina Park: redwood-inference/docs #1422 - `airgap: ca-bundle + hsm connectivity` (preflight checks running)

Omar Khan: Nice. Two immediate asks: 1) show how to import the CA bundle into the installer with `--airgap-ca-bundle /opt/offline/ca.pem`, 2) include an example of verifying the tarball with gpg and sha256sum. Also mention the offline mirror signature step.

Jules Meyer: Add a small CoreDNS snippet that forwards `kms.svc.internal` to vendor HSM IPs and sends everything else to a DoT upstream. Keep denial cache small for HSM hostnames. Also add a note about IPv6-only hosts for customers who run v6-only racks.

Lina Park: Dropping suggested snippets below so I can paste into the PR body. Please tweak.

Lina Park: ```
# verify bundle checksum and signature
sha256sum offline-bundle-2026-03-20.tar.gz
gpg --verify offline-bundle-2026-03-20.tar.gz.sig offline-bundle-2026-03-20.tar.gz

# installer usage
./installer --airgap --airgap-bundle /opt/offline/offline-bundle-2026-03-20.tar.gz --airgap-ca-bundle /opt/offline/ca.pem
```

Lina Park: CoreDNS example to include in docs:```
.:1053 {
    forward kms.svc.internal 10.10.5.8 10.10.5.9
    forward . 8.8.8.8 8.8.4.4 tls_servername=dot.example.net
    cache { success 1200 denial 20 }
    log
}
```

Omar Khan: For the GPG step mention keyring location and thumbprint check, e.g. `gpg --keyring /etc/redwood/keys.gpg --verify ...` and add the public key fingerprint in the doc so customers can audit it.

Jules Meyer: For HSM connectivity tests add two short commands customers can run after DNS is configured:
`dig +short @127.0.0.1 -p 1053 kms.svc.internal A`
`openssl s_client -connect 10.10.5.8:1792 -servername kms.svc.internal -CAfile /opt/offline/ca.pem`
Also call out that some HSM vendors use nonstandard RPC ports; include a sentence to check vendor docs.

Lina Park: Edge-case: Ubuntu systems with systemd-resolved sometimes capture port 53. I propose adding an nftables snippet to redirect traffic to the CoreDNS stub listener on 1053, plus a one-liner to stop systemd-resolved during the install window.

infra-eng: Suggest keeping the nftables example minimal; prefer the redirect over stopping systemd-resolved in docs (less risky). I'll paste a tested nftables rule from staging.

infra-eng: ```
# nftables redirect example
nft add table ip redwood
nft add chain ip redwood prerouting { type nat hook prerouting priority 0 ; }
nft add rule ip redwood prerouting udp dport 53 redirect to :1053
nft add rule ip redwood prerouting tcp dport 53 redirect to :1053
```

Omar Khan: Migration note for customers who previously used static hosts: include steps to remove /etc/hosts entries pointing at HSMs, apply new CoreDNS forwards, then run the openssl/connect smoke tests. Add a rollback note: if HSM client fails, re-add host entry and open a support ticket with `support@redwood.com` with the `install-id` and `resolver-dump` output.

Lina Park: Good call on support workflow. I'll include a short helper script that dumps `getent hosts`, `dig` output, and `ss` for tcp:1792 to attach to tickets.

security-bot: Preflight checks passed for #1422 - link and linter OK. Please ensure any internal repo links are not published publicly.

Jules Meyer: Small wording nit: use `Private (air-gapped)` in the user-facing docs. Also recommend `denial 20` for HSM names as we do a lot of quick failovers during rotation.

Lina Park: I ran the staging checklist in edge-lab-2: checksum/GPG steps worked, CoreDNS forwards fine, nftables redirect behaved as expected. One oddity: a particular HSM firmware returns intermittent TLS renegotiation errors under high load. I added a troubleshooting bullet suggesting `openssl s_client -tls1_2` and to check vendor logs.

Omar Khan: Thanks for validating. After you push the edits, we can merge and add a short release note. Also consider adding a tiny example `systemd` unit file for running CoreDNS on 127.0.0.1:1053 in the docs appendix.

Lina Park: Pushed updates, included systemd snippet and the helper dump script. Requesting one final review.

infra-eng: LGTM on the staging smoke results. Ready to merge after doc-owner signoff.

Lina Park: Merged. I'll open a follow-up to add an automated test in our install-e2e pipeline to verify the offline-bundle checksum and CoreDNS forward behavior. Closing thread.
